label: 南侧入口至东路展廊 · 连续通道资料模型
geometry: Continuous modern circulation from inside the southern Longhu gate via the east gallery to Tianhuang pavilion. Floor and path traced from THAD 1F plan; source-based context from the existing exterior model. No reconstructed relics.
siteTransform: Add siteLocalOrigin to interior point, then shared/geography.mjs modelLocalToWorld with the same shangqing geo. Viewer uses local metres and plan north. Floor datum 0.5 m matches existing exterior study, not surveyed elevation.
accuracy: Starts inside Longhu gate. Outside stairs are not part of the continuous route.
Published plan uses the prior approximate plan-to-imagery scale and alignment; metre values are estimates, not field navigation.
Eave/column/railing dimensions, floor height, roof section and material tones are photo-guided estimates, not measured elevations or scanned materials.
Archaeological excavation is represented only by footprint and an approximate recess. Masonry, artefacts and unmodelled rooms remain incomplete.
87 preserved background meshes match the original exterior coordinates after rebasing to within 0.000001 m; this validates model consistency only.

context.notes: 90 context mesh objects reused; overlapping east/south galleries and platforms removed from the copied context. Three roof groups trimmed. Original source file not modified.

materials: Six embedded original procedural stone/tile study textures. Stone joints estimated at 0.6 m; not photographed/scanned PBR. Steel, aluminium, painted timber tones approximate.
rights: Architectural drawings THAD, photos THAD / Wu Ji Photography retain original copyright. Local research study; public redistribution permission for source photographs not obtained. Model and procedural textures authored for this task.

build.scope: Connected circulation from inside the southern entrance through the east gallery to Tianhuang pavilion. Source-plan architectural study; archaeology details unmodelled.

reproduce: Set TEMP and TMP to [开发环境路径已省略]/tmp; set Blender config, scripts and datafiles under the same project cache directory.
Existing texture inputs: scripts/make_shangqing_route_stone.py and original shangqing source model with packed tile textures.
Copy exports/shangqing-entry-route.glb and sources companion to the website public/assets/models; retain original exterior and 29 m excerpt assets.
